title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29.1): Use batch totals for payment journals
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 2 adds a Batch Total (LCY) field to the Payment Journal page, displaying the cumulative total for payment batches to improve review and approval processes before posting.
key_points: New Batch Total (LCY) field displays sum of Amount (LCY) for visible payment journal lines
Batch total updates when line amounts change or batch name is selected, showing 0 for empty batches
Total accounts for line signs so positive and negative amounts offset each other
Improves payment processing control and streamlines review and approval workflows before posting or export
Not yet added to Cash Receipt Journals or General Journals as of this update
features: Batch Total (LCY) field on Payment Journal

quotes.text: Before you post or export a payment journal, review Batch Total (LCY) at the bottom of the page.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the new workflow step for verifying payment batches before committing transactions
